I LOVE this app! If you want to learn a certain language, so far, this has been the easiest option I could find! It has a lot of languages, even ones I didn't even know existed, like High Valarian for example. Anyway, great app, 5/5!

I quit using Duolingo for one reason; if I go offline, it saves NO progress. I can't DL more than a partial lesson for offline either. Even 3 lessons would be great! But I can do several lessons & it says I haven't. It gives the same lesson over & over. It never saves streaks either. If offline worked seamlessly, I'd consider paying a bit a month for other perks. It can't find my friends I also convinced to play. No fun.

Some things are truly awesome learning with Duolingo, but others are very upsetting. Update 22 August 2026. Many changes have happened and some are not good. As a non-verbal individual I am continually being requested to speak! I can assure you that this is a huge problem for me as I am unable to complete daily goals. I have emailed them regarding this issue to no avail.
